user.title: Connect to Teslatlas Hub
user.description: Enter a public Teslatlas Hub endpoint.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address advertised by Teslatlas Hub.
data_description.use_tls: Use the released public TLS transport.
data_description.tls_pin: Optional SHA-256 fingerprint from the private pairing invitation. Normal certificate trust is still required.

pair.title: Pair with Teslatlas Hub
pair.description: Enter the private invitation fields shown by your Hub. The invitation is not stored.

pair_validate.title: Verify Teslatlas Hub access
pair_validate.description: The invitation was claimed. Retry the authenticated check without creating another device credential.

reauth_confirm.title: Repair Teslatlas Hub authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a fresh private invitation from the same Hub.

reauth_validate.title: Verify repaired Teslatlas Hub access
reauth_validate.description: The fresh invitation was claimed. Retry the authenticated check without creating another device credential.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Change Teslatlas Hub endpoint
reconfigure_confirm.description: The new endpoint must resolve to the same Hub identity.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Hub
error.invalid_contract: The endpoint does not implement the supported current-Hub contract
error.protocol_not_ready: The released Teslatlas public protocol is not available yet

abort.cannot_connect: The discovered service has no usable endpoint
abort.wrong_hub: The endpoint resolved to a different Hub identity
